text: 1.Applicants should be in good physical and mental health. 2.Applicants should hold high school diploma or a form showing high school equivalency. 3.Applicants should apply for the major which is related to your previous: If applicants have completed the same major for the first year in other university or overseas, and their Chinese level has reached HSK level 4,they could take the second year course; If applicants have completed the same major for the second year in other university or overseas, and their Chinese level has reached HSK level 5, they could take the third year course.
